item.text:
Created a responsive university course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes Overview, Course Catalog, Registration, and Student Profile pages; course search and filters; interactive add/remove registration with a confirmation dialog; and a downloadable schedule. Accessibility features include semantic page structure, labeled controls, keyboard focus styles, a skip link, live updates, and reduced-motion support.

Open `index.html` in a browser to use it. The sample registration data is stored in memory and resets on refresh.
